# CyberWorld Automations

A CyberWorld Groups company. Founder: Ayodele Ezekiel.

GoHighLevel automation agency for real estate, home services and online coaches in the US, Canada and Europe.

## Services
CRM Setup & Migration; Sales Funnel Building; Automated Follow-Up Sequences; Appointment Booking Automation; Reputation Management; Pipeline & Workflow Automation.

## Pricing
Starter $1,500 one-time. Growth $3,000 one-time. Enterprise custom pricing. Free 30-minute strategy call. Typical build: about 14 days, scope agreed first.
